uncheckedRequirements.description: When a Header is constructed from a buffer and the computed size (from any source) is negative, header.size becomes undefined. (the task: "when a block is decoded, the size it computes (the extended header's size, else the global extended header's size, else the block's own size field) becomes undefined if it is negative")

When a Header is constructed with {size: -1000}, the negative size is ignored and header.size stays undefined. (the task: "header data whose size is negative when compared as a number, whether passed to the constructor (new Header({ size: -1000 })) or merged in from an extended header, is ignored, so header.size stays undefined")

When extended header data with negative size is merged into a Header, it is ignored and the existing size is preserved. (the task: "merged in from an extended header, is ignored, so header.size stays undefined")
In Pax.parse, a 'size' record whose numeric value is zero or greater is kept (positive test). (the task: "while 'size=1000' gives 1000 and 'size=0' gives 0")
In Pax.parse, a 'size' record with negative numeric value leaves size undefined. (the task: "'size=-1000' and a non-numeric value leave size undefined")
In Pax.parse, a 'size' record with a non-numeric value leaves size undefined. (the task: "'size=-1000' and a non-numeric value leave size undefined")
